account.note: RE-PULLED LIVE AT 15:35 ET BY THE PRE-CLOSE, against the mandated account after a scope preflight that matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY AS A STRING against the connector list - one match, no first-account default, no nickname match, no balance heuristic. Every other account was discarded unread and none is summarised, totalled or mentioned in this file, in runs.json, in why.json, in the commit message or in the operator report. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1011.15 total against 1011.15 cash, buying power 1011.15, equity_value 0, options_value 0, futures 0, crypto 0, pending_deposits 0, unsettled 0.0000. THE BALANCE IS UNCHANGED FROM EVERY READ TODAY AND FROM THE 9/1 CLOSE - the fifteenth consecutive identical read. The 1.99 credit the 9/1 open flagged as an unexplained non-trading item remains STABLE and remains FLAGGED rather than explained; this run also found no endpoint asserting a cause and does not assert one. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED and nothing is claimed against it: the 09:45 MDT specification expired unexecuted at 15:30, so the 372.28 it claimed is released and deployable returns to the full 1011.15 for tomorrow's open. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, so no +20% target, no -8% equity stop, no -40% option stop, no ~5 session time stop and NO OPTION NO-FLY WINDOW is reachable - each checked live at 15:35 rather than inherited from the 15:21 hourly, and the flat book is the decision this slot exists to make rather than the leftover it defaulted to. ZERO equity orders and ZERO option orders on a 2026-08-26 created_at floor confirm the flatness is not a stale read AND confirm the MDT specification was never resting at the broker - which is the reading that matters most today, because the limit was executable for the last eighty minutes of its life and an order that had been placed would have filled and would show here.

entryWatch.setup: MDT day-2 continuation after the 9/1 beat-and-raise - the name the 9/1 file flagged as worth this open's attention if it built a shelf. It built it. Medtronic reported fiscal Q1 2027 on 2026-09-01 am, EPS 1.45 against a 1.39 estimate, a 4.3% beat, with revenue 9.756B against 9.545B, FY27 EPS guidance raised to 5.94-6.00 and organic growth guidance raised to 7.25-7.75%. The 9/1 reaction bar opened 94.00, ran 95.41, flushed to 90.80 and closed 92.04 on 18.8M shares against roughly 6.5M typical - a faded gap that nonetheless HELD 1.53% above the 90.65 pre-print close, which is the exact line SAIC and NTNX failed. The afternoon based 92.24-92.96 for four hours. Today opened 91.47, below yesterday's close and below that base, held above the 90.80 reaction low, and reversed to a 93.39 high. SPECIFIED at 09:45 at a 93.07 limit for 4 shares, CLEAN, no checklist item marked fail, struck AT THE OFFER rather than under the bid as the direct correction to yesterday's DG failure.
entryWatch.trigger: EXPIRED UNEXECUTED AT ITS 15:30 FUSE, AND IT DIED EXECUTABLE RATHER THAN UNTOUCHED. Not killed - no invalidation ever fired and all six hourly re-quotes confirmed it. The 19:25Z bar, the last five minutes of the specification's life, opened 92.910 and CLOSED 92.710 on 93,078 shares, the heaviest bar of the half hour, so the 93.07 limit stood 0.36 or 0.39% ABOVE the tape at the moment it expired and would have filled instantly at the offer. The first quote after the fuse reads MDT 92.53 bid / 92.54 ask at 2026-09-02T19:35:40.110374188Z, last 92.540, +0.54% against a 92.04 settled close, on a 0.01 spread that is 0.011% of mark - the limit now 0.54 above the bid. IT WAS CONTINUOUSLY FILLABLE FOR EIGHTY MINUTES: MDT traded through 93.07 in the 18:10Z bar on a 92.940 low and never traded back above it, so every bar from 14:10 ET to the fuse was executable for a buy limit. The session-long gap history runs 0.86% under the bid, 1.16%, 0.82%, 0.42%, then 0.08% above, 0.22% above, and 0.39% above at the death. The limit was never raised through two hours of the name running to 94.605 and never lowered once the tape came to it. NOT RE-STRUCK FOR TOMORROW.
entryWatch.why: THE PRICE HYPOTHESIS IS NOW TESTED AND DEAD, WHICH IS THIS ENTRY'S REAL LEGACY. Yesterday's DG specification died 2.24% ABOVE its limit and the 9/1 pre-close diagnosed the cause as the RESTING LIMIT rather than the window - struck 0.38% under the bid and never touched. This entry was the correction: struck AT THE OFFER, deliberately marketable at the moment it was written, with the correction named in the 09:45 text as the point of the trade. IT WORKED. The limit went marketable at 14:10, stayed marketable for eighty minutes, and the operator was pinged twice carrying exactly that - at 14:21 when it first crossed and at 15:21 with seven minutes left. The entry still did not execute. A limit cannot be struck more favourably than one already through the offer, so no future re-strike can improve on this and the remaining constraint is delivery rather than price. THE COUNTERWEIGHT IS KEPT RATHER THAN DROPPED NOW THAT IT COSTS NOTHING TO KEEP: the relative-strength case inverted outright over the afternoon. MDT +0.54% against XLV +0.79% and SPY +0.46% is 0.68x its own sector, BELOW ONE for the first time today after 2.50x at 13:21, 1.19x at 14:21 and 1.08x at 15:21, on a fifth consecutive falling hourly read from 94.16 down to 92.53 bid. The fill that got away would have bought the day's fading medtech name at a limit struck when it was the leader. The setup itself never broke - 92.53 is 1.88 above the 90.65 pre-print close, the round-trip line that killed SAIC and NTNX - so this is a delivery finding rather than a thesis failure, and tomorrow's open writes tomorrow's entry on tomorrow's quotes rather than inheriting this level.

entryWatch.setup: DG discount-retail reclaim - the 9/1 specification at a 128.40 limit that expired unexecuted at 15:30
entryWatch.trigger: NOT RE-STRUCK, AND THE REFUSAL IS RE-AFFIRMED FOR A FIFTH TIME TODAY. Quoted at 09:45 at 131.94 bid / 132.37 ask, leaving the dead 128.40 limit 2.68% below the market; not re-quoted this hour because nothing this slot could learn about DG would make re-striking it permissible, and a row this run did not re-pull does not get this run's clock. The 2026-08-18 rule is explicit that widening the time was never permission to widen the price. What the companion case did this hour is come the rest of the way back: MDT's limit now sits 0.42% under its bid against 1.16% two hours ago, so on one of the two names the identical refusal is close to being rewarded outright rather than merely stopping a chase. That is the outcome this row has been waiting for on both, and it is recorded on the hour it looks good only because it was also recorded on the hours it looked expensive.
entryWatch.why: Kept as the standing example. The spec died VALID rather than wrong - none of its three invalidations fired - and it still did not fill, because it was struck 0.38% under the bid of a name that rose on every bar. Today's MDT entry is struck AT the offer for that reason, and this row is what that decision is answering.

entryWatch.setup: OLLI reaction bar after the 9/2 am print - the runner-up, refused on structure rather than on the beat
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED. OLLI is 75.67 bid / 76.15 ask at 2026-09-02T13:41:39.019258805Z, last 75.964, +4.60% against a 72.34 settled close, on a 0.63% spread. A 22.4% beat - 1.42 against a 1.16 estimate, reported this morning - and it is refused for three reasons that stack: TODAY IS ITS REACTION BAR and the rulebook buys the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds, not the print bar; the two sessions into it whipsawed hard, 8/31 closing +4.3% at 75.42 and 9/1 giving all of it back to 72.34 at -4.1%, so there is no shelf to strike against; and FIVE reports tonight into the same discount-consumer complex, which lands inside any five-session hold opened today. Worth the 9/3 and 9/4 opens' attention if it builds a shelf, on the same terms SAIC was given and failed and MDT was given and passed.
entryWatch.why: Recorded as the runner-up rather than dropped, because a mandated entry that does not name what it beat is not gradeable. If MDT fails and OLLI runs, this row is the evidence for whether the reaction-bar refusal was the right call or a reflex.

entryWatch.setup: SAIC post-earnings round-trip - the control case that gives the MDT setup its meaning
entryWatch.trigger: STILL REFUSED, AND STILL BREAKING DOWN. SAIC is 123.11 bid / 124.39 ask at 2026-09-02T13:41:55.491665676Z, last 123.50, -2.90% against a 126.78 settled close, on a 1.03% spread. That is a third consecutive lower session and it remains below its 125.96 pre-print close and below the 127.10 low of its own reaction bar. A 30.9% beat has now fully round-tripped and kept going.
entryWatch.why: This is the row MDT is graded against. Same shape at the start - a large beat, a gap, a fade - and opposite resolutions: SAIC lost its pre-print close on day 2 and MDT held 1.53% above it. The rulebook has no rule that says 'a big beat is a buy'; it has a rule about what the tape does with the gap, and these two names are the worked example of why.

entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND THE REFUSAL GIVES SOME BACK FOR THE FIRST TIME. entryWatch.why: Kept and updated in the direction that is less flattering. Yesterday this row read as a refusal that keeps paying; today the payoff shrank by a third in one session. A board that only updates a rule's scoreboard when the rule looks good is running an advertisement, not a record.
